question: Can the original 1988 proceedings chapter cited in the PIDS Caliraya abstract be accessed or retrieved through a legitimate catalog route?

target.chapterTitle: Fisheries Management Strategies in two reservoirs in the Philippines
target.volumeTitle: Reservoir fishery management and development in Asia: proceedings of a workshop held in Kathmandu, Nepal, 23-28 November 1987

sources.finding: The official PIDS working-paper PDF identifies the Guerrero-Manalili item on p. 202 as abstract only and reproduces a Caliraya/Magat summary. The proceedings chapter itself is not included in the retrieved PIDS PDF.

The National Institute of Informatics CiNii Books record confirms IDRC c1988, editor Sena S. De Silva, ISBN 0889365156, and a 246-page volume; it lists three library holdings in Japan. This is bibliographic metadata, not chapter text.

The National Museum of Ethnology Library catalog lists one physical copy as a loanable general book with status Available and displays interlibrary copy and borrowing request routes. The record does not establish eligibility for an international request or provide an electronic scan.

boundedChecks: Exact title and ISBN searches were run against IDRC-related indexed pages and Google Books; no publisher-hosted full text surfaced in those results.
The linked University of Tokyo and Mie University catalog pages returned HTTP 403 in this environment; their holdings are not inferred absent.
WorldCat's linked search page required JavaScript and returned no item-level holding details in this review.
National Museum of Ethnology, University of Tokyo and Mie University were listed as holdings institutions in the CiNii record; only the National Museum of Ethnology OPAC record was readable here.

accessDisposition.catalogHolding: National Museum of Ethnology Library lists an available, loanable general-book copy as of the review date.

reuse.chapterText: Not retrieved; no item-specific open license or public-app reuse permission verified.
reuse.decision: Do not extract or publish fish claims from the secondary abstract as if the chapter or its data had been reviewed.

limits: The PIDS reproduction is explicitly abstract only and does not expose sampling design, dates, stations, effort, sample size, or catch-data provenance.
Historical catch shares and stocking statements cannot establish current presence, abundance, catchability, diet, or a complete reservoir checklist.
Catalog availability is not proof that a copy can be borrowed internationally or that a scan can be supplied.
nextAction: Continue the CALABARZON inland-water sweep with accessible, waterbody-resolved sources while retaining the Minpaku holding as an optional library retrieval route.
